Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a program for offender education.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to offender education; and adding new sections tochapter 72.09 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 72.09 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department shall create, by rule, a program to provideoffenders with the opportunity to participate in programs designed toeducate offenders on American citizenship and civil rights. Theprogram shall include, but not be limited to educational components onthe following: (a) Responsible citizenship; (b) Rights lost to felony offenders and restoration, including gunownership and possession; (c) Voting laws and felony voting rights restoration; (d) Legal financial obligations; (e) Sex offender registration and community notification; and (f) Civic participation, including participation in local, state,and federal government processes, school boards, neighborhoodorganizations, and nonprofit or volunteer organizations. p. 1 SB 6488 (2) Upon satisfactory completion of a program, the department shallissue a certificate of completion to an offender.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 72.09 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department shall provide to offenders, before release intothe community, information regarding community service providers thatprovide educational services to offenders. (2) The department shall work in collaboration with communityservice providers that provide educational services to offenders todevelop a standard curriculum for education of offenders released intothe community.
